build_package_protos: build Python gRPC protobuf modules from all .proto files in a given package root directory
build_package_protos_strict: build Python gRPC protobuf modules from proto files and raise an exception on any compilation failure
run_build_package_protos_command: run the setuptools BuildPackageProtos command to generate *_pb2.py modules from proto files in a distribution
review_build_package_protos_class: review the BuildPackageProtos setuptools command class that generates gRPC protobuf Python modules from proto files
refactor_build_package_protos: refactor the build_package_protos function to support multiple include directories instead of a single package root
